name: ssmart-pos
description: SS Mart — Offline-first POS and inventory management
author: Manideep Daram

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && node src/server.js" "cd frontend && npx next dev -p 1994"
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && node src/server.js" "cd frontend && npx next start -p 1994"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npx next build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
